name: Iinazuke
source:
Shuuichirou Takase is a usual high school student who attends kendo club. One day his grandfather tells him that they are from very ancient family and that Shuuichirou must marry Sayaka Shizukawa and from now on they should live under the same roof.
Will Shuichirou accept his fate or make his own decisions in life?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
